description: This Java class defines Cucumber hooks for managing the WebDriver lifecycle during test scenarios. It initializes the driver before each scenario and captures a screenshot if the scenario fails, then quits the driver afterward.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: Cucumber hooks for managing WebDriver lifecycle per scenario, including setup, teardown, and screenshot capture.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new WebDriver instance before each scenario and logs scenario details.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: After each scenario, captures a screenshot if failed and quits the driver, logging scenario completion status.

methods.name: captureScreenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the current WebDriver state and attaches it to the Cucumber report.
